messages:
ana (PM): quick sync — customer requests a short SLA appendix (BYOK uptime, export windows, escrow). need numbers to attach to contracts.

mike (Eng-Sec): baseline: automated KMS failover ~5m; large export (100GB) ~30m on Dedicated. escrow/manual key export needs ops approval and can be 2-4h.

sasha (Legal): recommend tiered service credits only. propose table: minor (<4h)=0.5% MRR, major (4-24h)=1% MRR, critical (>24h)=2% MRR; caps: 10% per incident, 50% annual. exclusions: legal holds, customer key compromise, third-party KMS outage.

devin (AE): offer a paid "priority compliance lane" for 24h export SLA and faster escrow turnaround.

tina (CS): auditors require export manifest + signed hash + operator id; we should promise artifact delivery within 5 business days.

ana (PM): actions: legal draft appendix this week; eng estimate failover tests + manifest tooling (1w); eng prototype resumable export (Q4); cs collect top customer asks (EOD). syncing Fri 10am.
